description:
We are TerraMappers, a student team exploring how our home planet can help humanity prepare for life beyond Earth. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we’re using Earth, Moon, and Mars data to identify environments on Earth that could help researchers test technologies and plan future missions. Combining coding, research, and creative problem-solving, we aim to turn complex planetary data into an accessible tool for discovery.

Exploring Earth. Preparing for new worlds.
